missing[differentFrom] missing-inconsist.note: A class that gains a second distinct literal through a late owl:sameAs never re-checks dt-diff-class, so r differentFrom r (and eq-diff1) is not derived.

missing[differentFrom].note: The issue's repro: a functional property whose values only become literals through a late owl:sameAs. A fact whose own terms did not change is not re-seeded, so has-value / different-values is never re-run.

missing[type].note: A literal joining an existing class late does not type the class (xsd:string, rdfs:Literal) because dt-literal / dt-string are seeded by the t(s p o) fact, not by the class change.
